nodes.name: Theorem 24: tabular c RHMC with numerical integrators for $e^{-f}$ tabular
nodes.statement:
Let $\pi$ be a target distribution on a convex set $\mathbb{\mathcal{M}}\subset\mathbb{R}^{n}$
and $\Lambda=\sup_{S\subset\mathbb{\mathcal{M}}}\frac{\pi_{0}(S)}{\pi(S)}$ be the
warmness of the initial distribution $\pi_{0}$. Let $\mathbb{\mathcal{M}}$ be the
Hessian manifold with its metric induced by the Hessian of a strongly
self-concordant barrier and $\pi_{T}$ the distribution obtained after
$T$ steps of RHMC discretized by a numerical integrator
on $\mathbb{\mathcal{M}}$. For any $\varepsilon>0$, let $\rho=\frac{\varepsilon}{2\Lambda}$
and $\mathbb{\mathcal{M}}_{\rho}$ any good region. If step size $h$ guarantees
the sensitivity of the integrator and 
\begin{align*}
h^{2} & \leq\frac{10^{-10}}{\max(R_{1},\bar{R}_{1})},\ h^{5}\leq\frac{\ell_{0}}{10^{3}R_{1}^{2}\ell_{1}},\ h^{3}R_{2}+h^{2}R_{3}\leq1,\ h\leq\frac{1}{10^{10}}\min\left(1,\frac{\ell_{0}}{\ell_{1}}\right),\ h^{2}\leq\frac{10^{-10}}{n+\sqrt{M_{1}}+M_{2}},\\
h & C_{x}(x,v)\leq\frac{10^{-10}}{\sqrt{n}},\ h^{2}C_{x}(x,v)\leq10^{-10}\min\left(1,\frac{\bar{\ell}_{0}}{\bar{\ell}_{1}},\frac{1}{n+\sqrt{M_{1}}+\sqrt{M_{1}^{*}}}\right),\ h^{2}C_{v}(x,v)\leq\frac{10^{-10}}{\sqrt{n+\sqrt{M_{1}}}}
\end{align*}
for $x\in\mathbb{\mathcal{M}}_{\rho}$ and $v\in V_{\text{good}}^{x}=\left\{ v\in\mathbb{R}^{n}:\left\Vert v\right\Vert_{g^{-1}}\leq128\sqrt{n},\ \bar{\ell}(\mathrm{Ham}_{x,t}(g(x)^{-1}v))\leq\frac{1}{2}\bar{\ell}_{0}\right\}$
(see (6.1)), where the parameters are defined in Definition
11, 13 and 23,
then for the isoperimetry $\psi_{\mathbb{\mathcal{M}}_{\rho}}$ of $\mathbb{\mathcal{M}}_{\rho}$
there exists $T=O\left(\left(h\psi_{\mathbb{\mathcal{M}}_{\rho}}\right)^{-2}\log\frac{1}{\rho}\right)$
such that $d_{\text{TV}}(\pi_{T},\pi)\leq\varepsilon$.

nodes.name: \protect Lemma 14: tabular c Coupling of ideal tabular
nodes.statement:
For $x,y\in\mathbb{\mathcal{M}}_{\rho}$ and step size
$h\leq\min\left(\frac{1}{10^{5}R_{1}^{1/2}},\left(\frac{\ell_{0}}{10^{3}R_{1}^{2}\ell_{1}}\right)^{1/5}\right)$,
if $d_{\phi}(x,y)\leq\frac{1}{100}\min\left(1,\frac{\ell_{0}}{\ell_{1}}\right)$,
then
\[
d_{\text{TV}}(\mathcal{P}_{x},\mathcal{P}_{y})\leq O\left(\frac{1}{h}+h^{2}R_{2}+hR_{3}\right)d_{\phi}(x,y)+\frac{1}{25}.
\]

nodes.name: \protect Lemma 29: tabular c Coupling between ideal discretized tabular
nodes.statement:
For $x\in\mathbb{\mathcal{M}}_{\rho}$ and $v\in V_{\text{good}}^{x}$,
let step size $h$ guarantee the sensitivity of a numerical
integrator at $(x,v)$, and satisfy
\[
\underbrace{h^{2}\leq\frac{10^{-10}}{n+\sqrt{M_{1}}+M_{2}}}_{\textcircled{\small{1}}},\underbrace{h^{2}\leq\frac{10^{-10}}{\bar{R}_{1}}}_{\textcircled{\small{2}}},\underbrace{C_{x}(x,v)h^{2}\leq\frac{1}{10^{10}}\min\left(1,\frac{\bar{\ell}_{0}}{\bar{\ell}_{1}}\right)}_{\textcircled{\small{3}}},\underbrace{C_{x}(x,v)h\leq\frac{1}{10^{10}\sqrt{n}}}_{\textcircled{\small{4}}}.
\]
Then $d_{\text{TV}}(\overline{\mathcal{P}}_{x},\mathcal{P}_{x})\leq\frac{1}{10}$.

nodes.name: \protect Lemma 32: tabular c Rejection probability tabular
nodes.statement:
Let $(x_{h},v_{h})$ and $(\bar{x},\bar{v})$ be the
points obtained by the ideal RHMC and discretized RHMC with a sensitive
numerical integrator starting at $x\in\mathbb{\mathcal{M}}_{\rho}$
with $v\in V_{\text{good}}^{x}$. If the step size $h$ satisfies 
\[
h^{2}\leq\frac{10^{-10}}{n+\sqrt{M_{1}}+M_{2}},\:h^{2}C_{x}(x,v)\leq\frac{10^{-10}}{n+\sqrt{M_{1}}+\sqrt{M_{1}^{*}}},\,h^{2}C_{v}(x,v)\leq\frac{10^{-10}}{\sqrt{n+\sqrt{M_{1}}}},
\]
then the rejection probability of the Metropolis filter is bounded
by $10^{-3}$.

nodes.name: Theorem 2: tabular c RHMC with numerical integrators for $e^{-\alpha^{\top}x}$ in polytope tabular
nodes.statement:
Let $\pi$ be a target distribution on a polytope with $m$ constraints
in $\mathbb{R}^{n}$ such that $\frac{d\pi}{dx}\sim e^{-\alpha^{\top}x}$ for
$\alpha\in\mathbb{R}^{n}$. Let $\mathbb{\mathcal{M}}$ be the Hessian manifold of the polytope
induced by the logarithmic barrier of the polytope. Let $\Lambda=\sup_{S\subset\mathbb{\mathcal{M}}}\frac{\pi_{0}(S)}{\pi(S)}$
be the warmness of the initial distribution $\pi_{0}$. Let $\pi_{T}$
be the distribution obtained after $T$ steps of RHMC discretized
by a sensitive integrator on $\mathbb{\mathcal{M}}$. For any $\varepsilon>0$,
if for $x\in\mathbb{\mathcal{M}}_{\frac{\varepsilon}{2\Lambda}}$ and $v\in\mathbb{R}^{n}$ randomly
drawn from $\mathcal{N}(0,g(x))$, we have that with probability at least
$0.99,$ step size $h\leq h_0(x,v)$,
\[
h\leq\frac{10^{-20}}{n^{7/12}\log^{1/2}\frac{\Lambda}{\varepsilon}},\ hC_{x}(x,v)\leq\frac{10^{-20}}{\sqrt{n}},\ h^{2}C_{x}(x,v)\leq\frac{10^{-10}}{n\log\frac{\Lambda}{\varepsilon}}\text{ and }h^{2}C_{v}(x,v)\leq\frac{10^{-10}}{\sqrt{n\log\frac{\Lambda}{\varepsilon}}},
\]
then $d_{\text{TV}}(\pi_{T},\pi)\leq\varepsilon$ for $T=O\left(mh^{-2}\log\frac{\Lambda}{\varepsilon}\right)$.

nodes.name: Corollary 4, Corollary 5: tabular c RHMC with IMM LM for $e^{-\alpha^{\top}x}$ in polytope tabular
nodes.statement:
Let $\pi$ be a target distribution on a polytope with $m$ constraints
in $\mathbb{R}^{n}$ such that $\frac{d\pi}{dx}\sim e^{-\alpha^{\top}x}$ for
$\alpha\in\mathbb{R}^{n}$. Let $\mathbb{\mathcal{M}}$ be the Hessian manifold of the polytope
induced by the logarithmic barrier of the polytope. Let $\Lambda=\sup_{S\subset\mathbb{\mathcal{M}}}\frac{\pi_{0}(S)}{\pi(S)}$
be the warmness of the initial distribution $\pi_{0}$. Let $\pi_{T}$
be the distribution obtained after $T$ iterations of RHMC discretized
by IMM on $\mathbb{\mathcal{M}}$. For any $\varepsilon>0$ and step size $h=O\left(\frac{1}{n^{3/2}\log\frac{\Lambda}{\varepsilon}}\right)$,
there exists $T=O\left(mn^{3}\log^{3}\frac{\Lambda}{\varepsilon}\right)$ such
that $d_{\text{TV}}(\pi_{T},\pi)\leq\varepsilon$.

induced by the logarithmic barrier of the polytope. Let $\Lambda=\sup_{S\subset\mathbb{\mathcal{M}}}\frac{\pi_{0}(S)}{\pi(S)}$
be the warmness of the initial distribution $\pi_{0}$. Let $\pi_{T}$
be the distribution obtained after $T$ iterations of RHMC discretized
by LM on $\mathbb{\mathcal{M}}$. For any $\varepsilon>0$ and step size $h=O\left(\frac{1}{n^{3/2}\log\frac{\Lambda}{\varepsilon}}\right)$,
